title: Types of Sarees in India by State: Weaves, GI Tags and How to Recognise Each
seoTitle: Types of Sarees in India: State-wise List with GI Tags
seoDescription: Types of sarees in India by state: Kancheepuram, Banarasi, Paithani, Patola, Chanderi and more, with official GI tag year and how to recognise each weave.
excerpt: A state-by-state table of about 30 handloom sarees with the exact GI registry name and year, the border, motif and fibre clues that set lookalikes apart, and popular names like kasavu that are not GI-registered.
